items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: a man by the name of Mr. Brown, who was going to chaperone us... Mr. Brown, we didn't do any other work for him.

ctx.x: Well Budd, I just want to get back to this, then. When did you first -- now you, this is about 1927, and you all got the Blue Moon Chasers, not when did you get up to around Kansas City? When did you get out of Texas? When is the first time you guys, like when either you and Keg went on your own?
Okay, that's a little story before this, and this is leading up to what you asked me.
In 19 and 27 we got a call from a guy by the name of Eugene Coy, that is my brother and myself got this call, after we were back from one of these --
